interpretation_rule: Every concept is a versioned operational hypothesis. Definitions from practitioner schools are not treated as proven alpha until independently tested with frozen rules and out-of-sample data.

concepts.name: Fair Value Gap
concepts.operational_rule: At completed bar t, bullish if high[t-2] < low[t]; bearish if low[t-2] > high[t]. Zone boundaries are those two prices.
concepts.invalidation: Rule changes only after a separate, versioned fill/mitigation policy.

concepts.name: Liquidity sweep
concepts.operational_rule: Two confirmed pivots within 0.15 ATR define a pool; a later completed bar trades beyond pool by tolerance then closes back through it.
concepts.invalidation: Close through the opposite side of the sweep premise.

concepts.name: Order block
concepts.operational_rule: Requires a frozen definition such as last opposite candle before independently defined displacement and structure break; zone and mitigation policy must be explicit.
concepts.invalidation: Zone breach defined by chosen policy.

concepts.name: Optimal Trade Entry / PD arrays
concepts.operational_rule: Retracement bands, premium/discount and dealing ranges must be parameterized from a declared completed swing; no implicit discretionary anchor.
concepts.invalidation: Anchor swing invalidated/replaced by rule.

concepts.name: Order-block proxy
concepts.operational_rule: v0.1: final opposing candle before a >=1.25 ATR body displacement, conditioned on confirmed HH/HL or LH/LL structure.
concepts.invalidation: Bullish: close below block low; bearish: close above block high.

concepts.name: BOS, CHoCH, MSS
concepts.operational_rule: A structure event must name pivot confirmation lag, break threshold, close-versus-wick basis and prior trend state. v0.1 price-action engine reports only confirmed HH/HL/LH/LL and close break proxy.
concepts.invalidation: A later confirmed opposite structure sequence.

concepts.name: Accumulation/distribution phases
concepts.operational_rule: Candidate state machine over range boundaries, relative volume, springs/upthrusts and sign of strength/weakness. Must be labelled probabilistic, not annotated after the fact.
concepts.invalidation: State-transition rule or range failure.

concepts.name: Spring / upthrust
concepts.operational_rule: Range boundary excursion followed by close back inside on a completed bar; require predeclared range and volume treatment.
concepts.invalidation: Close beyond failed side with configured tolerance.

concepts.name: Market structure
concepts.operational_rule: v0.1 uses two confirmed pivot highs and lows (wing=2): HH+HL is uptrend; LH+LL downtrend; else range/mixed.
concepts.invalidation: Confirmed opposite pivot sequence or configured close break.

concepts.name: Three-bar imbalance
concepts.operational_rule: Same raw condition as the FVG detector but held as a price-action label; central engine tags it correlated with ICT/SMC structure.
concepts.invalidation: Versioned zone-fill policy.

concepts.name: Supply/demand zone
concepts.operational_rule: Base before an impulsive move; requires mechanical base length, displacement threshold, freshness and touch-count parameters.
concepts.invalidation: Configured zone penetration/close.

concepts.name: Chart patterns and trend lines
concepts.operational_rule: Represent as geometric constraints with tolerances and a breakout confirmation/cost model; never label visually post hoc.
concepts.invalidation: Pattern-specific boundary failure.

concepts.name: Support/resistance
concepts.operational_rule: Cluster confirmed pivots by ATR-normalized price distance, retaining touch count and age.
concepts.invalidation: Configured close-through or regime shift.

concepts.name: Resting-liquidity proxy
concepts.operational_rule: OHLC cannot observe resting orders; equal highs/lows are only a proxy hypothesis. Actual liquidity requires L2/order-book data.
concepts.invalidation: Data-type mismatch must block assertion.

concepts.name: Auction/profile value area
concepts.operational_rule: Build time-price opportunity or volume-at-price histogram from session data, document session and bin size; derive POC/value-area mechanically.
concepts.invalidation: Session definition/data-quality failure.

concepts.name: POC and value area
concepts.operational_rule: Use actual trade volume at price when available; broker tick-volume is not a substitute without a documented proxy study.
concepts.invalidation: No valid volume-at-price input.

concepts.name: Delta/CVD
concepts.operational_rule: Classify aggressor-side trades under a declared quote/trade-signing rule, aggregate buy minus sell volume, retain unknown-class rate.
concepts.invalidation: Missing trade/quote data or excessive unclassified prints.

concepts.name: Footprint
concepts.operational_rule: Price-level bid/ask executed volume matrix; requires tick/market-by-order or equivalent vendor data and explicit session roll treatment.
concepts.invalidation: OHLCV-only feed cannot produce a footprint.

concepts.name: Retracement/extension
concepts.operational_rule: Select a confirmed anchor swing by rule; calculate fixed ratios and test as a feature, not causal law.
concepts.invalidation: Anchor replacement rule.

concepts.name: Trend baseline
concepts.operational_rule: v0.1: 20/50 SMA direction only if 20-bar realized-volatility percentile proxy <= 0.90; parameters frozen per experiment.
concepts.invalidation: Average cross or volatility gate breach.

concepts.name: Regime detection
concepts.operational_rule: Start with transparent trend/range/high-volatility rules; compare later HMM/classifier only on locked out-of-sample performance.
concepts.invalidation: Regime confidence below threshold or model drift.

concepts.name: Scheduled-event risk
concepts.operational_rule: Store event release time in UTC, consensus/actual/revision provenance and an embargo policy. Do not infer news from price after release.
concepts.invalidation: Missing event timestamp or provider lineage.

concepts.name: Regime classifier
concepts.operational_rule: Feature timestamps must precede label; use purged/temporal validation and compare versus transparent regime baseline. Deploy only if independent improvement clears a precommitted threshold.
concepts.invalidation: Drift, calibration failure, or no OOS lift.

concepts.name: Walk-forward validation
concepts.operational_rule: Chronological expanding/rolling train folds strictly precede test folds. Final holdout stays unopened until selection freezes.
concepts.invalidation: Any train/test overlap or tuning on final holdout.

concepts.name: Probability of Backtest Overfitting
concepts.operational_rule: Apply CSCV/PBO to candidate trial-return matrix where applicable; record all trials, not just selected winners.
concepts.invalidation: Missing trial ledger or insufficient design assumptions.

concepts.name: Deflated Sharpe Ratio
concepts.operational_rule: Assess Sharpe with trial-count and return-distribution assumptions documented; never report it as a standalone guarantee.
concepts.invalidation: Undocumented trials/assumptions.

concepts.name: Event embargo
concepts.operational_rule: Block new entries during a configurable window around high-impact scheduled events; different instruments require explicit calendar mapping.
concepts.invalidation: Calendar unavailable/stale means risk state must become unknown, not safe.

concepts.name: Imbalance
concepts.operational_rule: A separately named SMC imbalance must state its completed-bar condition, zone boundaries and mitigation rule. v0.1 aliases no extra score beyond its market-structure correlation group.
concepts.invalidation: Versioned fill/mitigation policy.

concepts.name: Confirmed swing
concepts.operational_rule: v0.1 marks a high/low only after wing=2 later closed bars; unconfirmed latest extrema are not signals.
concepts.invalidation: A later bar may prevent an extrema from becoming confirmed; confirmed pivot remains an historical observation.

concepts.name: Relative volume
concepts.operational_rule: Compare current completed-bar volume with an explicitly selected trailing distribution and same-session semantics when available; preserve whether it is trade or tick volume.
concepts.invalidation: Provider volume semantics missing or changed.

concepts.name: Support and resistance
concepts.operational_rule: Cluster confirmed swing prices using an ATR-normalized tolerance and record touches, age and resolution; do not draw subjective lines.
concepts.invalidation: Configured close-through threshold or time expiry.

concepts.name: Order-book imbalance
concepts.operational_rule: Calculate displayed bid/ask depth imbalance only from synchronized order-book updates, preserving venue, depth and cancellation/latency limitations.
concepts.invalidation: Stale, gapped or cross-venue mixed order book.
